title: Major Medical Facility Authorization Act of 2020
official_summary:
Major Medical Facility Authorization Act of 2020

This bill authorizes the Department of Veterans Affairs to carry out specified major medical facility projects during FY2020. The bill also indicates the maximum amount that can be spent on each project.

summary.headline: This 2020 law lets the Department of Veterans Affairs carry out specified major medical facility projects during fiscal year 2020, with a spending cap for each project.
summary.what_it_does: The law gives the Department of Veterans Affairs permission to carry out certain major medical facility projects during fiscal year 2020. It also sets the maximum amount that may be spent on each listed project. The short official summary does not name the projects or list the dollar limits, so those details are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who receive health care through the VA
who_it_affects.how: The law authorizes VA building and renovation projects at medical facilities, which may affect where and how VA health care is delivered in the projects' locations.

who_it_affects.group: VA medical facility staff and construction contractors
who_it_affects.how: The projects authorized by the law would be planned, funded up to the stated caps, and built under VA oversight.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted June 16, 2020, with authority covering fiscal year 2020, which ended September 30, 2020.
